## Workflow steps (from transcript)

_Reconstructed from ASR transcript; uncertain items marked [verify]._

1. Have a saved parcel file ("ເຊບຟile" [verify] = a saved .qgs project / parcel layer) with the points to be cut.
2. Enable snapping first: right-click ("ຄິກຂວາ") → open the snapping ("Sap ping to" [verify]) tool, and the side "Layer" tab ("ແທບທາງຂ້າງ layer") — so the cut follows the parcel boundary.
3. Layer → Create → temporary layer ("tempary") — one point: the place where the cut starts ("ຈຸດທຶໜຶ່ງ... ເຮົາຈະເລີ່ມຈາກຈຸດນີ້"). Set the geometry to point ("ຈຸດ"); set the CRS to "48n" [verify — UTM North, likely EPSG:32647 WGS84/UTM 47N]; "OK". The new layer appears.
4. Digitize the point at the start of the cut ("s້າງຈຸດ... ໄວ້ແຈນີ້").
5. Vector → GeoProcessing tools ("go processing tool") → "Buffer" ("ບuເຟີ"): input layer = the point layer; distance = the split size in meters (e.g. "15" meters = "15 ແມດ"); "run" ("ລັນ") — a 15 m cut circle appears.
   - Note: if the size is set too small ("ກຳນົດຕ່ຳເກີນໄປ"), the result becomes a squashed shape ("ຮູບແບບເປັນລຽມໆ") rather than a true circle — keep the buffer centered ("ຢູ່ທາງກາງໆ").
6. If the circle is too small / overlapping ("ບັງ"), open the layer properties ("layer proper") and adjust the symbol ("ຊມບໂລ") size and transparency ("ຄວາມໂປ່ງໃສ") → "OK".
7. Mark the split point ("ໝາຍໄວ້ໃຫ້ມັນ") — "save"; close. Result: a split point ("ຈຸດຕັດ").
8. Repeat for a second cut: create the second temporary point layer ("ຈຸດທີສອງກະພຽງແຕ່ສ້າງອັນ... ຈຸດທີສອງ"), geometry = point, CRS "48n" ("ເລືອກເປັນ 48N ຄືເກົ່າ"), mark it; buffer 15 ("ບີ... ເອົາ 15 ຄືກັນ"); mark and "save"; close.
9. To keep splitting, continue grabbing the next point ("ຈັບຈຸດ... ໄປເລີຍ") with the create ("cre") tool and cut ("ຕັດ") along — "a buffer shape, a circle, so it won't be off ("ວົງມົນ... ບໍ່ມັນຈະບໍ່ຜິດດ່ຽງ")".
